name: stats-test
description: Descriptive statistics and classical hypothesis tests for numeric series. "describe" gives n/mean/median/stdev/min/max/quartiles/skewness; "ttest" gives Welch's (or paired) t-statistic, degrees of freedom and a two-tailed p-value; "regression" gives OLS slope/intercept/r2/stderr for a simple linear fit; "correlation" gives Pearson or Spearman r plus a two-tailed p-value. Use this instead of eyeballing raw numbers or hand-computing t-statistics whenever a decision depends on whether a difference or relationship is statistically meaningful.

b.description: Second sample. Required for "ttest" and "correlation"; must be the same length as "a" when paired or for correlation.

paired.description: ttest only: run a paired t-test on a-b differences instead of Welch's independent-samples test. Default false.

y.description: Dependent variable. Required for mode "regression"; must be the same length as "x".

method.description: correlation only: which coefficient to compute. Default "pearson".

t.description: null when the input degenerates (e.g. zero-variance samples); see notes.

df.description: null when the input degenerates (e.g. zero-variance samples); see notes.

p.description: null when t/df or r is null, or when there are zero degrees of freedom; see notes.

slope.description: null when x has zero variance (constant); see notes.

intercept.description: null when x has zero variance (constant); see notes.

r2.description: null when x has zero variance (constant); see notes.

stderr.description: null when n<3 or x has zero variance; see notes.

r.description: null when a series has zero variance (constant); see notes.

notes.description: Explanations for any null field above, e.g. 'stdev undefined for n<2'. Empty when nothing in the result is null.
